import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current
from lib import *

ARM = "left"
TOL_RISE = 0.05          # the held bowl must rise at least this much
T1_XY = np.array([-0.2536, -0.1067])

before = measure_bowls()
for b in before:
    print("bowl", b["cand"], "axis", b["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist(), "rim_z", round(b["aabb_max"][2],4))
pick = nearest(before, T1_XY)
print("picking", pick["cand"], pick["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist(), "ref", pick["ref"])

flange, u, r_out = rim_grasp_flange(pick, ARM, dz_pad=-0.005)
pre = flange + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.10])
print("flange", flange.round(4).tolist(), "pregrasp", pre.round(4).tolist(), "u", u.round(3).tolist())

r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(vert_point(pre), approach=down_dir(), jaw_line=jaw_dir(u),
                                          interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
check(r, "pregrasp")
p_now = current().pose(ARM).position
print("tcp after pregrasp", p_now.xyz.tolist(), "miss", float(p_now.distance(vert_point(pre))))

r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(vert_point(flange), approach=down_dir(), jaw_line=jaw_dir(u),
                                          interaction="contact_approach")}, speed="normal", slow_approaching=True)
check(r, "grasp approach")

r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "close"})
print("[close] ok", r.ok, r.status, "aperture", getattr(r, "measured_opening", None), "raw", str(r["result"])[:300])

lift = flange + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.12])
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(vert_point(lift), approach=down_dir(), jaw_line=jaw_dir(u),
                                          interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
check(r, "lift")

after = measure_bowls()
print("--- after lift ---")
for b in after:
    print("bowl", b["cand"], "axis", b["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist(), "rim_z", round(b["aabb_max"][2],4))

held = max(after, key=lambda b: b["aabb_max"][2])
rise = float(held["aabb_max"][2] - pick["aabb_max"][2])
print("held", held["cand"], "rise_m", round(rise,4), "tol", TOL_RISE)
if rise < TOL_RISE:
    handoff("bowl did not rise with gripper", rise_m=rise, tol_m=TOL_RISE,
            held=held["cand"], before_rim=float(pick["aabb_max"][2]))
# geometry of the grasped bowl relative to the flange
tcp = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)
nominal_axis = flange[:2] - u * r_out
print("nominal held axis xy", nominal_axis.round(4).tolist(), " measured", held["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist(),
      " delta", (held["axis_xy"] - nominal_axis).round(4).tolist())
print("tcp xy", tcp[:2].round(4).tolist(), "measured axis minus tcp", (held["axis_xy"] - tcp[:2]).round(4).tolist())
print("measured bowl base z", round(float(held["support_z"]),4), "rim z", round(float(held["aabb_max"][2]),4),
      "rim minus tcp z", round(float(held["aabb_max"][2] - tcp[2]),4))
json.dump({"held_axis_xy": held["axis_xy"].tolist(), "tcp_xy": tcp[:2].tolist(), "tcp_z": float(tcp[2]),
           "held_rim_z": float(held["aabb_max"][2]), "held_support_z": float(held["support_z"]),
           "base_xy": pick["axis_xy"].tolist(), "u": u.tolist(), "r_out": r_out,
           "bowls": [{"cand": b["cand"], "axis": b["axis_xy"].tolist(), "rim_z": float(b["aabb_max"][2]),
                      "support": float(b["support_z"]), "ref": b["ref"]} for b in after]},
          open("/work/state_after_pick1.json","w"), indent=1)

for b in bowls:

    print("bowl", b["cand"], "axis", b["axis_xy"].round(3).tolist(), "zmin", round(float(b["aabb_min"][2]),4),
          "zmax", round(float(b["aabb_max"][2]),4), "extent", b["extent"].round(3).tolist(), "ref", b["ref"])
T1_XY = np.array([-0.25, -0.19])
pick = nearest(bowls, T1_XY)
print("regrasping", pick["cand"], pick["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist())

# tilt of the free bowl: principal axes
r = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="bowl", max_candidates=3)
for c in r["result"]["candidates"]:
    if c["target_ref"] != pick["ref"]:
        continue
    g = object_geometry(c)
    ax = np.array(g.principal_axes_world); ex = np.array(g.principal_extents_m)
    i = int(np.argmin(ex))
    print("free bowl extents", ex.round(4).tolist(), "smallest-axis", ax[i].round(3).tolist(),
          "tilt_deg", round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(min(1.0, abs(float(ax[i][2])))))),1))

pl = tools.grasp_plan(arm=ARM, target_ref=pick["ref"], max_candidates=3)
cands = pl["result"]["candidates"]
chosen = None
for c in cands:
    ik = c["ik_reachability"]
    print("cand", c["candidate_id"], "score", round(c["backend_score"],3), "opening_mm", round(c["gripper_opening_m"]*1000,1),
          "reachable", ik.get("reachable"), "tilt_deg", ik.get("approach_tilt_from_vertical_deg"),
          "contact", np.round(np.array(c["contact_pose"]["position_m"]),3).tolist())
    if ik.get("reachable") and chosen is None:
        chosen = c
if chosen is None:
    handoff("no reachable grasp candidate", n=len(cands))
print("chosen", chosen["candidate_id"])
try:
    r = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=chosen["candidate_id"],
                            rationale="wall-perpendicular rim grasp gives planar pad contact for a stable upright carry")
except ToolRefused as e:
    handoff("grasp_execute refused", code=e.code, answer=str(e.answer)[:600])
print("grasp_execute status", r.status, r.ok)
print(json.dumps(r["result"].get("stages"), default=str)[:1500])
print("verification", json.dumps(r["result"].get("verification"), default=str)[:600])
tools.wait_ticks(6)
after = measure_bowls()
for b in after:
    print("bowl", b["cand"], "axis", b["axis_xy"].round(3).tolist(), "zmin", round(float(b["aabb_min"][2]),4),
          "zmax", round(float(b["aabb_max"][2]),4), "extent", b["extent"].round(3).tolist())
r2 = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="bowl", max_candidates=3)
for c in r2["result"]["candidates"]:
    g = object_geometry(c)
    ax = np.array(g.principal_axes_world); ex = np.array(g.principal_extents_m)
    i = int(np.argmin(ex))
    print("cand", c["candidate_id"], "bbox", c["bbox_xyxy"], "extents", ex.round(3).tolist(),
          "tilt_deg", round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(min(1.0, abs(float(ax[i][2])))))),1))

import numpy as np
from robot import tools, handoff, target, ToolRefused
from ora_lib import current, Point
from lib import *

ARM = "left"
BASE_XY = np.array([-0.035, -0.211])      # base bowl T0
DROP_CLEAR_M = 0.022                      # release this far above the nested position
ALIGN_TOL_M = 0.006

bowls = measure_bowls()
for b in bowls:
    print("bowl", b["cand"], "axis", b["axis_xy"].round(3).tolist(), "zmin", round(float(b["aabb_min"][2]),4),
          "zmax", round(float(b["aabb_max"][2]),4))
held = max(bowls, key=lambda b: float(b["aabb_min"][2]))
base = nearest(bowls, BASE_XY)
assert held is not base
print("held", held["cand"], held["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist(), " base", base["cand"], base["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist())

tcp = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)
off = held["axis_xy"] - tcp[:2]           # flange -> held bowl axis (xy)
target_flange = base["axis_xy"] - off
print("flange now", tcp.round(4).tolist(), "offset", off.round(4).tolist(), "target flange", target_flange.round(3).tolist())

r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point([float(target_flange[0]), float(target_flange[1]), float(tcp[2] + 0.10)], "world"),
                                          interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
check(r, "transfer")
tcp = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)

# re-measure and correct alignment
b2 = measure_bowls()
held2 = max(b2, key=lambda b: float(b["aabb_min"][2]))
base2 = nearest(b2, BASE_XY)
err = held2["axis_xy"] - base2["axis_xy"]
print("after transfer: held", held2["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist(), "err_xy", err.round(4).tolist(),
      "zmin", round(float(held2["aabb_min"][2]),4))
if float(np.linalg.norm(err)) > ALIGN_TOL_M:
    corr = base2["axis_xy"] - err
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point([float(corr[0]), float(corr[1]), float(tcp[2])], "world"),
                                              interaction="precision")}, speed="careful")
    print("[correct]", r.ok, r.status, "err was", float(np.linalg.norm(err)))
    check(r, "align correction")
    tcp = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)
    b2 = measure_bowls()
    held2 = max(b2, key=lambda b: float(b["aabb_min"][2]))
    base2 = nearest(b2, BASE_XY)
    err = held2["axis_xy"] - base2["axis_xy"]
    print("after correction err_xy", err.round(4).tolist())

nested_bottom = float(base2["support"]) + 0.008
target_bottom = nested_bottom + DROP_CLEAR_M
zmin = float(held2["aabb_min"][2])
descent = zmin - target_bottom
print("held bottom", round(zmin,4), "nested_bottom_est", round(nested_bottom,4),
      "target_bottom", round(target_bottom,4), "descent", round(descent,4))

steps = []
rem = descent
for s in (0.040, 0.030, 0.020, 0.012, 0.008, 0.008):
    if rem <= 0.002:
        break
    d = min(s, rem); steps.append(d); rem -= d
print("descent steps", [round(s,4) for s in steps])
z = float(tcp[2])
for i, d in enumerate(steps):
    z -= d
    try:
        r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point([float(tcp[0]), float(tcp[1]), z], "world"),
                                                  interaction="precision")}, speed="careful")
        print(f"[descend {i}] ok={r.ok} status={r.status} err={r.target_error_m}")
        if not r.ok:
            break
    except ToolRefused as e:
        print(f"[descend {i}] REFUSED {e.code}: {str(e.answer)[:200]}")
        z += d
        break
print("flange z now", round(z,4))
import json
json.dump({"flange_xy": tcp[:2].tolist(), "flange_z": z, "offsets": off.tolist()}, open("/work/place1_state.json","w"))

    print("[raise]", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code)
except ToolRefused as e:
    print("[raise] REFUSED", e.code, str(e.answer)[:200])
r = tools.wait_ticks(8); print("[wait2]", r.ok, r.status)

# measure geometry of each bowl including tilt
g = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="bowl", max_candidates=3)
rows = []
for c in g["result"]["candidates"]:
    og = object_geometry(c)
    ax = np.array(og.principal_axes_world); ex = np.array(og.principal_extents_m)
    i = int(np.argmin(ex))
    tilt = float(np.degrees(np.arccos(min(1.0, abs(float(ax[i][2]))))))
    mn = np.array(og.aabb_min_xyz_m); mx = np.array(og.aabb_max_xyz_m)
    rows.append(dict(cand=c["candidate_id"], ref=c["target_ref"], bbox=c["bbox_xyxy"],
                     axis=np.array([(mn[0]+mx[0])/2, (mn[1]+mx[1])/2]),
                     zmin=float(mn[2]), zmax=float(mx[2]), tilt=tilt,
                     ext=np.array(og.extent_xyz_m), support=float(og.support_z_m)))
    print(json.dumps({k: (v.round(4).tolist() if hasattr(v,'round') else (round(v,4) if isinstance(v,float) else v))
                      for k,v in rows[-1].items()}))
base = nearest([r for r in rows], BASE_XY)

above = [r for r in rows if r is not base and r["zmax"] > base["zmax"] + 0.005]
print("bowls above base:", [(r["cand"], r["axis"].round(3).tolist(), round(r["zmin"],4)) for r in above])
for r2 in rows:
    if r2 is base: continue
    d = float(np.linalg.norm(r2["axis"] - base["axis"]))
    print("cand", r2["cand"], "xy_dist_to_base", round(d,4), "zmin", round(r2["zmin"],4),
          "zmax", round(r2["zmax"],4), "tilt", round(r2["tilt"],1))
json.dump(rows, open("/work/after_release1.json","w"), default=lambda o: o.tolist() if hasattr(o,"tolist") else str(o), indent=1)

import numpy as np, json

from ora_lib import current, Point, Direction, object_geometry
from lib import measure_bowls, nearest

ARM = "left"
STACK_XY = np.array([-0.038, -0.209])
ALIGN_TOL_M = 0.006
RELEASE_FLANGE_Z = 1.0230

obs = current()
tcp = np.array(obs.pose(ARM).position.xyz)
ap = Direction(np.array(obs.pose(ARM).axis("x")).tolist(), "world")
jw = Direction(np.array(obs.pose(ARM).axis("y")).tolist(), "world")

def held_and_stack():
    bowls = measure_bowls()
    held = max(bowls, key=lambda b: float(b["aabb_min"][2]))
    others = [b for b in bowls if b is not held]
    stack = nearest(others, STACK_XY)
    return bowls, held, stack

bowls, held, stack = held_and_stack()
print("held", held["cand"], held["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist(), "zmin", round(float(held["aabb_min"][2]),4))
print("stack", stack["cand"], stack["axis_xy"].round(4).tolist(), "rim", round(float(stack["aabb_max"][2]),4))
off = held["axis_xy"] - tcp[:2]
transfer = np.array([STACK_XY[0]-off[0], STACK_XY[1]-off[1], RELEASE_FLANGE_Z + 0.05])
print("offset", off.round(4).tolist(), "transfer flange", transfer.round(4).tolist())

r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(transfer.tolist(), "world"), approach=ap, jaw_line=jw,
                                          interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("[transfer]", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code)
if not r.ok: handoff("transfer failed", failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)
tcp = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)

bowls, held, stack = held_and_stack()
err = held["axis_xy"] - stack["axis_xy"]

      "err", err.round(4).tolist(), "zmin", round(float(held["aabb_min"][2]),4),
      "stack_rim", round(float(stack["aabb_max"][2]),4))
if float(np.linalg.norm(err)) > ALIGN_TOL_M:
    corr = np.array([tcp[0] - err[0], tcp[1] - err[1]])
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point([float(corr[0]), float(corr[1]), float(tcp[2])], "world"),
                                              approach=ap, jaw_line=jw, interaction="precision")}, speed="careful")
    print("[correct]", r.ok, r.status)
    tcp = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)
    bowls, held, stack = held_and_stack()
    err = held["axis_xy"] - stack["axis_xy"]
    print("post-correction err", err.round(4).tolist())

z = float(tcp[2])
for i, d in enumerate((0.020, 0.020, 0.010)):

r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "open"}); print("[open]", r.ok, r.status)

import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, handoff, target, ToolRefused, query
from ora_lib import current, Point, Direction, object_geometry, geometry
from lib import measure_bowls
from geom import pose7

ARM = "left"
STACK_XY = np.array([-0.037, -0.207])
BETA = np.deg2rad(26.0)
LINK6_TO_JAW = 0.1501
R_RIM = 0.0705
CONTACT_DEPTH = 0.010
R_FLANGE = LINK6_TO_JAW*np.sin(BETA) + R_RIM
Z_OFF = LINK6_TO_JAW*np.cos(BETA) - CONTACT_DEPTH

def fit_circle_3d(P):
    P = np.asarray(P, float); c = P.mean(axis=0); Q = P - c
    u, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(Q, full_matrices=False)
    n = vt[2]; e1, e2 = vt[0], vt[1]
    x = Q@e1; y = Q@e2
    A = np.column_stack([2*x, 2*y, np.ones(len(x))]); b = x**2+y**2
    sol, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, b, rcond=None)
    cx, cy = sol[0], sol[1]
    r = float(np.sqrt(max(sol[2]+cx**2+cy**2, 0.0)))
    ctr = c + cx*e1 + cy*e2
    return ctr, r, n/np.linalg.norm(n), float(np.std(np.sqrt((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2)-r))

def rim_fit(cand, obs):
    t = obs.target(cand["target_ref"]); cam = obs.camera(t.camera)
    pts = geometry.mask_to_cloud(cam.depth_m, cam.K, t.mask)
    W = geometry.transform_points(pts, cam.camera_to_world)
    W = W[np.isfinite(W).all(axis=1)]
    z = W[:,2]
    P = W[z >= z.max()-0.003]
    return fit_circle_3d(P), float(z.max()), float(z.min())

obs = current()
g = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="bowl", max_candidates=3)
rows = []
for c in g["result"]["candidates"]:
    og = object_geometry(c)
    ctr, r, nrm, sd = None, None, None, None
    try:
        (ctr, r, nrm, sd), zmx, zmn = rim_fit(c, obs)
    except Exception as e:
        zmx = zmn = None
    rows.append(dict(cand=c["candidate_id"], ref=c["target_ref"], ext=np.array(og.extent_xyz_m),
                     aabb_min=np.array(og.aabb_min_xyz_m), aabb_max=np.array(og.aabb_max_xyz_m),
                     rim=ctr, rr=r, tilt=None if nrm is None else float(np.degrees(np.arccos(abs(nrm[2])))), sd=sd,
                     zmx=zmx, zmn=zmn))
    print(c["candidate_id"], "ext", np.round(og.extent_xyz_m,3).tolist(),
          "rim_ctr", None if ctr is None else np.round(ctr,4).tolist(),
          "r", None if r is None else round(r,4), "tilt", None if nrm is None else round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(abs(nrm[2])))),1),
          "sd", None if sd is None else round(sd,5), "zmax", None if zmx is None else round(zmx,4))

def bowlish(r):
    e = np.sort(np.asarray(r["ext"]))[::-1]
    return e[0] > 0.11 and e[1] > 0.11 and e[2] < 0.07 and r["rim"] is not None and 0.06 < r["rr"] < 0.09
cands = [r for r in rows if bowlish(r)]
print("bowl-like:", [(r["cand"], np.round(r["rim"],3).tolist()) for r in cands])
if len(cands) < 2:
    handoff("could not resolve the bowls reliably", n=len(cands))
free = min(cands, key=lambda r: float(np.linalg.norm(r["rim"][:2] - np.array([-0.388,-0.002]))))
stack = min(cands, key=lambda r: float(np.linalg.norm(r["rim"][:2] - STACK_XY)))
if free is stack: handoff("free bowl and stack resolved to same candidate")
print("free bowl", free["cand"], np.round(free["rim"],4).tolist(), "stack top rim", np.round(stack["rim"],4).tolist())
json.dump(dict(free_axis=free["rim"][:2].tolist(), free_zmax=free["zmx"], free_zmin=free["zmn"],
               stack_axis=stack["rim"][:2].tolist(), stack_rim_z=stack["zmx"]),
          open("/work/state3.json","w"), indent=1)

axis = free["rim"][:2]; rim_z = free["zmx"]
phi = np.deg2rad(270.0)
w = np.array([np.cos(phi), np.sin(phi), 0.0]); zhat = np.array([0,0,1.0])
approach = -np.sin(BETA)*w - np.cos(BETA)*zhat
jaw = np.cos(BETA)*w - np.sin(BETA)*zhat
flange = np.array([axis[0] + R_FLANGE*w[0], axis[1] + R_FLANGE*w[1], rim_z + Z_OFF])
pre = flange - 0.10*approach
print("R_FLANGE", round(R_FLANGE,4), "Z_OFF", round(Z_OFF,4))
print("flange", flange.round(4).tolist(), "pregrasp", pre.round(4).tolist())
rc = query("reach_check", arm=ARM, poses=[pose7(pre, approach, jaw), pose7(flange, approach, jaw)],
           interaction="precision")
for nm, row in zip(("pregrasp","grasp"), rc["results"]):
    print(nm, "reachable", row["reachable"], "margin", row["joint_limit_margin_deg"], row["reason"])
if not all(row["reachable"] for row in rc["results"]):
    handoff("grasp poses unreachable", detail=str(rc["results"])[:400])

ap = Direction(approach.tolist(), "world"); jw = Direction(jaw.tolist(), "world")
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(pre.tolist(), "world"), approach=ap, jaw_line=jw,
                                          interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("[pregrasp]", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code)
if not r.ok: handoff("pregrasp failed", summary=r.summary)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(flange.tolist(), "world"), approach=ap, jaw_line=jw,
                                          interaction="contact_approach")}, speed="normal", slow_approaching=True)
print("[approach]", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code)
tcp = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)
print("tcp", tcp.round(4).tolist(), "miss", round(float(np.linalg.norm(tcp-flange)),5))
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "close"}); print("[close]", r.ok, r.status, r.summary)
r = tools.wait_ticks(3)
lift = tcp + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.11])
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(lift.tolist(), "world"), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("[lift]", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code)
r = tools.wait_ticks(4)
obs = current()
g = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="bowl", max_candidates=3)
for c in g["result"]["candidates"]:
    og = object_geometry(c)
    try:
        (ctr, rr, nrm, sd), zmx, zmn = rim_fit(c, obs)
    except Exception:
        continue
    print("cand", c["candidate_id"], "ext", np.round(og.extent_xyz_m,3).tolist(),
          "rim", np.round(ctr,4).tolist(), "r", round(rr,4),
          "tilt", round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(abs(nrm[2])))),1), "zmin", round(zmn,4), "zmax", round(zmx,4))
print("tcp now", np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz).round(4).tolist())
